solutionSql:
SELECT to_char(s.booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS booking_month,
       COUNT(*)::integer AS unbilled_shipments
FROM shipments AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices AS i WHERE i.shipment_id = s.id)
GROUP BY to_char(s.booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY booking_month;

ambiguities.readingChosen: Month of booked_at converted to UTC with AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', so the result does not depend on the session time zone
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Month of booked_at in the session time zone (UTC in the sample, so identical there)

ambiguities.readingChosen: No row in invoices with that shipment_id (anti-join via NOT EXISTS); paid or unpaid invoices both count as billed
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Treat unpaid invoices (paid_at IS NULL) as unbilled; rejected because the ticket says billed whether or not paid

notes: Anti-join with NOT EXISTS, grouped by to_char(booked_at AT TIME ZONE UTC, YYYY-MM), count cast to integer, ordered by month. Months with no unbilled shipments are omitted as instructed. Sample: 35 unbilled of 240 shipments; 205 invoices, one per shipment.
